value.rationale: The Petersen graph is a canonical symmetric cubic benchmark, and exact topology of ordinary Morse complexes remains available only for limited families. The two adjacent nonzero top-dimensional mod-2 homology groups are a natural exact invariant that materially sharpens generic connectivity information and provide a reproducible test case for structural theory.
